status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Texans placed McDonald (ankle) on injured reserve Friday.
status.longComment: McDonald was limited in practice Wednesday and missed practice Thursday, suggesting he suffered the injury in practice this week. He'll now be required to miss at least the first four games of the season. Logan Hall, Mario Edwards and Jaden Crumedy will see the rotational snaps at defensive tackle behind Tommy Togiai and Sheldon Rankins.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: To'oTo'o (shoulder) was placed on the injured reserve list Tuesday, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.
status.longComment: To'oTo'o suffered a shoulder injury late in Sunday's 36-31 loss to Buffalo. He will now miss a minimum of four games, meaning he is not eligible to return until at least the Week 6 clash with the Jaguars.

status.label: Doubtful
status.shortComment: Hummel (groin) is considered week-to-week, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
status.longComment: Hummel suffered a groin injury in the third quarter of Sunday's 36-31 loss to the Bills. The linebacker will almost certainly miss the Texans' Week 2 game against the Bengals. Jake Hansen will likely start as the second outside linebacker in Hummel's absence, but the team will probably rely on more nickel packages with Jalen Pitre in the slot while Hummel is absent.
